title: Residue differential kernel and cokernel for the p-root presentation
statement: Let p be prime, A a commutative local F_p-algebra and a : Fin n → A. For the actual p-root quotient B of [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-algebra-local], there is a local ring instance and the map A → B is local. Put L = B/m_B and beta : L tensor_A Omega[A/F_p] → L tensor_B Omega[B/F_p], the L-scalar extension of mapBaseChange with its source reassociated. Then ker beta is the L-span of (1 tensor d a_i), and the L-dimension of the cokernel of beta is n. No independence of the a_i, Noetherianity, or geometric regularity is assumed. Differentials are [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials].

source.place: Tag 07E5, proof of (2) => (4); read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07E5 because the local literature checkout is absent. The exact sequence after tensoring with K′; the splitting and tensor reassociation are proved explicitly in Lean.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-algebra-local] for the local instance and local coefficient homomorphism. Set w=mapBaseChange, z=the relative differential map and epsilon=the coefficient differential linear combination. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-presentation-differentials] to obtain a relative differential basis, Exact epsilon w, Exact w z and surjectivity of z.

The relative basis makes its module free, hence projective. Split z by [lem-weil-pbc-ses-projective-quotient-splits]. The explicit projection q=id-s z lands in ker z and retracts its inclusion. Its scalar extension still retracts that inclusion, so the scalar-extended inclusion is injective. Corestrict w to ker z; it is surjective by exactness. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-right-exact] to epsilon followed by this corestriction, then compose with the injective inclusion. This proves Exact epsilon_L w_L. Right exactness applied to w,z also proves Exact w_L z_L and surjectivity of z_L. This is the fully proved private helper baseChange_exact_of_projective_cokernel and its application.

Reassociate the source using TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange. Exactness gives ker w_L=range epsilon_L. LinearMap.lTensor_range, Finsupp.range_linearCombination, Submodule.baseChange_span and Submodule.map_span identify the transported kernel with span(1 tensor d a_i). Reassociation is surjective, so it does not change the range. The first isomorphism theorem for z_L identifies the quotient by this range with L tensor_B Omega[B/A]. The scalar-extended relative basis has n elements, so its dimension is n. The actual Lean proof handles n=0 without a special case.

lean.statement:
theorem pthRoot_residue_differentials (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra (ZMod p) A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (a : Fin n → A) :
    ∃ hlocal : IsLocalRing (pthRootAlgebra p n A a),
      letI := hlocal
      IsLocalHom (algebraMap A (pthRootAlgebra p n A a)) ∧
      let B := pthRootAlgebra p n A a
      let L := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
      let β := residueDifferentialComparison p A B
      β.ker = Submodule.span L (Set.range (fun i : Fin n ↦
        (1 : L) ⊗ₜ[A] KaehlerDifferential.D (ZMod p) A (a i))) ∧
      Module.finrank L ((L ⊗[B] KaehlerDifferential (ZMod p) B) ⧸ β.range) = n
